tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: The logo's green, exact. Fill of the seal mark and the brand's identity color in both themes.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The logo's cream, exact. The letter ع and rings on forest.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background and the 3D scene's clear color: the logo's forest at night, its cream by day.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised panels: order sheet, product drawer, header on scroll.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: The seal stage disc behind a product, input wells, footer.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only (below 3:1 by design). Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, chip and stepper borders. 3:1+ on ground, surface and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body text on ground, surface and surface-sunk (10.7:1+). The logo's own pair.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: volume, captions, helper text, on ground, surface and surface-sunk (5.6:1+).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Added accent, from the perfume cap: primary button fill, prices, focus ring, the outer ring of the seal stage. As text on ground, surface and surface-sunk (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: brass-bright
tokens.usage: Hover of brass fills and specular color for 3D brass. Day value is decorative only, not text.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brass fill (6:1 night, 5.7:1 day).

tokens.name: oud
tokens.usage: Oud-amber: perfume juice in 3D, 'new' and 'limited' tags. As text on ground and surface-sunk only (4.5:1+).

tokens.name: pole-red
tokens.usage: Barber-pole stripe only (loader, scroll progress). Decorative, never text or state.

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: Fill of the one 'send order on WhatsApp' button. Used nowhere else.

tokens.name: on-whatsapp
tokens.usage: Text and icon on the whatsapp fill (7.3:1 night, 5:1 day). Never white: white on WhatsApp green fails contrast.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero wordmark only. Drops to display-lg under 720px.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Openers of the three worlds: الحلاقة، العطور، العناية.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Product name on the detail stage.

styles.name: latin-mark
styles.usage: The Latin name, as the logo sets it: Amiri capitals, tracked. Only for the name.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel titles, product name on cards.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: عطر شرقي بنفحات العود والعنبر، يدوم طويلاً.
styles.usage: Product story paragraphs. Arabic needs the generous leading.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Helper and legal text. Never below 13px for Arabic.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Prices, in brass. Western digits, shekel sign before the number.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding, tight stacks, the gap between the seal's two rings.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Mobile gutter, card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between product cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding, desktop gutter.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on phones; the footer's top padding there.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Between scroll scenes on mobile.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Between scroll scenes on desktop; gives the 3D camera room to travel.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: Inputs, quantity stepper, order rows. Razor-sharp, on purpose.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels and drawers.

tokens.name: radius-seal
tokens.usage: The seal: circular product stage and its rings, avatar of the mark. The signature shape, from the logo.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and category chips.

tokens.name: shadow-stage
tokens.usage: Inside the seal disc: depth behind the floating product.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: Brass glow around the hovered product's seal and the primary button.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Order sheet rising from the bottom edge.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: U5.2 stacking: the layer being covered dims under this, from 0 to full as the next layer rises over it.

tokens.name: z-canvas
tokens.usage: The fixed full-page 3D canvas.

tokens.name: z-content
tokens.usage: Scrolling HTML over the canvas.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky header.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Order sheet and its scrim.
